question: Does the first-moment perturbation remain magnitude-scaled through the full 7200 -> 15420 continuation of writer A, or does the continuation enter a generic amplification regime in which small initial differences grow and rotate independently of the erased-moment direction?
writer: A only: stock OneCycle seed 2, checkpoints/phase19m/m007200.pt (sha256 a0cdf244fcf44f05...), Adam step 7200, one seed lineage, byte-identical future stream
intervention: exp_avg <- (1 - epsilon) exp_avg at the anchor; exp_avg_sq, Adam step counter, weights, wd, scheduler state, batch order preserved

readouts.dW: W_eps(7200+h) - W_C(7200+h), GLOBAL float64 over the 59 trained tensors, fresh fmel1 arms only
readouts.alpha: least-squares slope of ln||dW_eps(h)|| against ln eps over the four epsilons
readouts.cosmin: min over the 6 epsilon pairs of cos(dW_eps(h), dW_eps'(h))
readouts.function: HELD-32 CE per arm (UGC0 panel 00eb6c43...), dCE_eps = CE_eps - CE_C
readouts.gate: 120 gate at 15420 on C and e1, same mps device, descriptive only

provenance_decision: uniform continuous rerun of all five arms from 7200; historical Stage-0 C and FME1 Z / E snapshots are reference DIGESTS for an in-line qualification only (read from the locked receipts logs/oma1/stage0.json and logs/fme1/treat.json), never data; dependency set = locked receipts + anchor file; payloads under checkpoints/oma1/A/C and checkpoints/fme1 retained until BAR 0 passes, disposition then an Artin decision

bars.0_qualification: at h in {1,5,20,100,900}: fresh C digest == Stage-0 C digest, fresh e1 == FME1 Z digest, fresh e1e-2 == FME1 E digest, bit-exact; any mismatch aborts the run -> NOT-RUN, no control rerun, no relaunch without amendment
bars.1_first_step: |n_1(1) - 0.894284652673395| <= 0.02 and |R_eps(1) - 1| <= 1e-3 for every eps (checked in the one-step preflight); failure -> REGIME-UNRESOLVED, the rung books NOT-ADJUDICABLE, no long leg is run
bars.2_regime_at_H: first match wins: FORGOTTEN if n_eps(H) <= 0.05 for all four; REGIME-UNRESOLVED if alpha(H) or cosmin(H) is UNDEFINED (zero-norm law) or the preflight failed; MAGNITUDE-SCALED PERSISTENT if 0.80 <= alpha(H) <= 1.20 and cosmin(H) >= 0.90 and n_1(H) >= 0.25; NONLINEAR DIRECTION-SHARED if cosmin(H) >= 0.90 and alpha(H) outside [0.80, 1.20]; TRAJECTORY-SENSITIVE if alpha(H) <= 0.20 and cosmin(H) <= 0.50; else INTERMEDIATE with alpha(H) and cosmin(H) quoted
bars.3_transition_locus: reported: h_lin = last grid h with 0.80 <= alpha(h) <= 1.20 and cosmin(h) >= 0.90; h_dec = first grid h with cosmin(h) <= 0.50; UNDEFINED horizons excluded; 'not reached' legal
bars.4_function: per arm: NEUTRAL iff |dCE_eps(H)| <= 0.005; HARMED if dCE > 0.005; HELPED if dCE < -0.005; FUNCTION-NEUTRAL when all four NEUTRAL; scaling / sensitivity of dCE across eps reported descriptively; descriptive list of (eps, h) with |dCE| > 0.005
bars.label: (BAR 2 regime, BAR 4 function) [writer A only, one anchor, one seed lineage, CPU deterministic; gate descriptive], h_lin / h_dec quoted
bars.preflight: one step per arm from a fresh bind on the first future slice BEFORE any long leg: for every eps |R_eps(1) - 1| <= 1e-3 AND cos(dW_eps(1), dW_1(1)) >= 0.999 AND |n_1(1) - n_pred| <= 0.02; failure writes the receipt with label REGIME-UNRESOLVED and stops; on pass the long legs run from a fresh bind and every arm's h = 1 digest is asserted equal to its preflight digest (mismatch -> NOT-RUN)
bars.zero_norm_law: ||dW|| == 0 -> n = 0, R = 0 if ||dW_1|| > 0 else UNDEFINED, ln||dW|| UNDEFINED, cosine with a zero vector UNDEFINED; alpha over the eps with defined ln, UNDEFINED with fewer than four; cosmin UNDEFINED if any pair UNDEFINED; UNDEFINED stored as JSON null + reason; never NaN
bars.6_substrate_provenance: descriptive only, no threshold, no effect on BAR 2 / 4: fresh C(15420) v checkpoints/gallery19m_phase_s2.pt (digest 4633efe5d376f911..., sha e7207b3bd4df541a...): rho_end = ||W_C - W_booked|| / ||W_booked - W_7200||, HELD-32 CE both, 120 gate both on the same mps device; fresh C at step 15300 v checkpoints/phase19m/m015300.pt (digest d97b19e0ff3c84e5..., sha 6a715beb6394e3b3...) in-line: rho_15300 + HELD-32 CE both
